comment: EmulatR storage device catalog. AUTHORITATIVE at runtime (SPEC-STORAGE-001, architect 2026-08-04): the emulator loads this file; deviceLib/scsi/DriveProfile.h reduces to struct definitions. POLICY: EmulatR supports ONLY the devices in 'drives'. A device is admitted when an authoritative reference for its identity and geometry is held and cited, or it is declared SYNTHETIC and is coherent by construction. GENERIC IDENTITY (C-8): EmulatR volumes do not impersonate DEC drives; they present EMULATR identity and OpenVMS assigns DT$_GENERIC_DK 54 (0x36). Identity and geometry are INDEPENDENT surfaces (C-9) -- a generic identity still reports true geometry via MODE SENSE 04h and READ CAPACITY. Devices removed from the schema-1 catalog are in 'withdrawn' with the evidence needed to reinstate. ASCII(128) only.

policy.admission: A drive enters 'drives' only when every populated field carries an authority string. No recalled values. See JRN-DISK-002 G-2.
policy.geometry_absent: A drive for which no geometry authority is held does NOT get a row with nulls -- it stays in 'withdrawn' until a document is located (architect decision 2026-08-04).
policy.band_rule: Geometry sanity is a +/- 2 percent BAND against total_sectors, never an equality assert. These are banded (ZBR) drives whose published sectors_per_track is a flattened average. An equality check hard-stops two of the three DEC profiles.
policy.last_lba_rule: EK-SM2DR-PN.B01 'Sectors/drive' is the LAST LBA, not the count. total_sectors = that value PLUS ONE. READ CAPACITY returns last_lba.
policy.custom_drives: Entries in 'custom_drives' are ARCHITECT-AUTHORED and hand-editable. They are loaded AFTER 'drives' and may define devices for which no document exists, provided the values come from a MEASURED capture on a non-EmulatR system. 'drives' is the curated, authority-gated whitelist and should not be hand-edited; 'custom_drives' is where manual geometry lives.
policy.generic_identity: SPEC-STORAGE-001 C-8. Do not add a DEC drive identity to a volume EmulatR serves. Asserting RZ29L claims staggered spin-up, tagged queuing, sync negotiation and real ZBR banding that are not modelled -- the same reasoning that ruled inquiry_byte7 to 00h.
policy.revision_discriminator: Product strings stay stable for legacy byte-compatibility; the 4-byte REVISION distinguishes profiles in an SDA INQUIRY dump (EXAMINE <buf>;36, bytes 32-35). Without it every generic volume is indistinguishable in a capture.
policy.inquiry_byte7: 0x00 on EVERY profile. Byte 7 is a CAPABILITY ASSERTION the initiator acts on, not a label. SCSI-2 6.6.17.3 requires a non-queueing target to MESSAGE REJECT queue tag messages; EmulatR neither rejects them nor implements a queue, so bit 1 (CmdQue) invites a protocol it cannot complete. Measured cost of getting this wrong: 61,748 unexplained operations on the OpenVMS mount path. Bit 4 (Sync) likewise.

authority_kinds.document: A cited hardware reference. Field 'authority' names document, table, and page.
authority_kinds.measured: Captured from a running system that is NOT EmulatR (Charon, or real hardware). Field 'authority' names the command, the host, and the capture date. Capturing from EmulatR itself is CIRCULAR and is not an authority.
authority_kinds.synthetic: An EmulatR-defined device with no real-world counterpart. Coherent by construction; the construction is the authority.

identity.authority: EK-SM2DR-PN.B01 title page (DS-RZ28L-VA); string form per EK-KZPBA-UG.B01  inquiry_byte7 = 0x00, RESOLVED 2026-08-04 (JRN-AUD-004 DEC-1 / PLAN-SCSI-001 D-4). Was 0x12, a semantic derivation from the EK-SM2DR-PN.B01 feature list ('Tagged command queuing and multi-initiator support') -- true of the REAL drive, never of this target, and never a byte-level witness. MEASURED consumer: crash dump DKA0 UCB 81C67040 -- byte 7 = 0x12 on the wire, VMS set DK_FLAGS cmdq+port_cmdq, the HBA silently swallows tag messages (N-7), DK_UNEXPLAINED = 61,748 of 61,750 ops and DKA0 never went VALID. Re-assert only with Phase C-3 tagged queuing + C-2 reselection.

RZ29.priority: HIGHEST -- DT$_RZ29 is the only RZ29-family code that exists (JRN-DISK-002 F-1), so it is the leading candidate for what DKA0 presents.

custom_drives._comment: Hand-editable devices built from measured captures. Loaded after 'drives'; a key here SHADOWS the same key in 'drives'. Every entry must carry an 'origin' block naming the capture command, the host, and the date -- a capture taken from EmulatR itself is CIRCULAR and is not an authority (see authority_kinds.measured).

_show_device_full_mapping._note: Field mapping from OpenVMS DCL: SHOW DEVICE/FULL <dev>. Only these lines describe the DEVICE; everything else on that display is filesystem or volume state and must NOT be copied into a drive definition.
_show_device_full_mapping.device type <name>: guest.openvms.presented_type   -- the DT$_ symbol VMS RENDERS, not necessarily the drive's part number
_show_device_full_mapping.Total blocks: capacity.total_sectors         -- last_lba is this MINUS ONE
_show_device_full_mapping.Default buffer size: capacity.bytes_per_sector      -- 512 on every ODS volume seen so far; confirm per capture
_show_device_full_mapping._not_available_note: SHOW DEVICE/FULL does not expose INQUIRY data. Those fields need SDA (UCB$L_DK_INQUIRY_DATA) or a document; leave them null rather than guessing.
_show_device_full_mapping._coherence_check: sectors_per_track * tracks_per_cylinder * cylinders vs total_sectors must land inside the +/- 2 percent band (policy.band_rule). If it lands EXACT the capture is self-consistent.

origin.command: SHOW DEVICE/FULL DEV20$DKA0:  AND  F$GETDVI("DKA0", ...) lexicals
origin.volume_state: mounted, ODS-5, label ALPHASYS -- the C2 state

identity.note: SHOW DEVICE/FULL carries no INQUIRY data. Promote from SDA UCB$L_DK_INQUIRY_DATA on the same host.

capacity.authority: MEASURED, Charon: F$GETDVI MAXBLOCK 8380080; SHOW DEVICE/FULL Total blocks 8380080

geometry.authority: MEASURED, Charon: F$GETDVI SECTORS 113 / TRACKS 20 / CYLINDERS 3708, corroborated by DEVDEPEND 243012721 (0x0E7C1471 -> 113/20/3708) and by SHOW DEVICE/FULL
geometry.coherence: 113 * 20 * 3708 = 8380080 == MAXBLOCK EXACTLY. Three independent reads agree (F$GETDVI scalars, DEVDEPEND packed longword, SHOW DEVICE/FULL) and all three match the EK-SM2DR-PN.B01 RZ29L values.

openvms.authority: MEASURED, Charon: F$GETDVI DEVTYPE returns 137 decimal (0x89) and DEVCLASS 1. This is UCB$B_DEVTYPE read numerically -- not a rendered name. Symbol per JRN-DISK-002 Sec 4.

notes: WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES: a device with RZ29L geometry and capacity is assigned DT$_RZ29 137 (0x89) by OpenVMS V8.3. Read NUMERICALLY from the UCB, not inferred from a rendered name. Empirical confirmation of JRN-DISK-002 F-1 and F-4; settles O-2. The marker is DEVTYPE == 137, never the string RZ29L.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the geometry of a REAL RZ29. The captured geometry is RZ29L's. This is almost certainly an RZ29L (or an emulation of one) resolving to the nearest existing DT$_ code. Do NOT promote these values into a withdrawn/RZ29 reinstatement -- that still needs a document.
The absent identity block is the reason this lives in custom_drives and not in drives: it does not meet the admission policy.

_f_getdvi_mapping._note: PREFERRED capture method. OpenVMS DCL F$GETDVI lexicals return NUMERIC values straight out of the UCB -- no rendered names to pattern-match, and DEVDEPEND cross-checks the other three. Run on a NON-EmulatR system (Charon or real hardware); running it against EmulatR reads back our own profile and is circular.
_f_getdvi_mapping.DEVTYPE: guest.openvms.dcdef_code       -- numeric UCB$B_DEVTYPE. 137 = DT$_RZ29, 54 = DT$_GENERIC_DK (identity did not resolve)
_f_getdvi_mapping.DEVCLASS: must be 1 (DC$_DISK) for a drive entry
_f_getdvi_mapping.MAXBLOCK: capacity.total_sectors         -- last_lba is this MINUS ONE
_f_getdvi_mapping.DEVDEPEND: CROSS-CHECK ONLY, not a stored field. UCB$L_DEVDEPEND packs the geometry: byte 0 = sectors/track, byte 1 = tracks/cylinder, bytes 2-3 = cylinders. Decode it and it must equal SECTORS/TRACKS/CYLINDERS; if it disagrees the capture is bad, not the drive.
_f_getdvi_mapping._not_available_note: F$GETDVI has no INQUIRY item. Identity needs SDA against UCB$L_DK_INQUIRY_DATA on the same host.
_f_getdvi_mapping._coherence_check: SECTORS * TRACKS * CYLINDERS vs MAXBLOCK must land inside the +/- 2 percent band (policy.band_rule). EXACT means the capture is self-consistent.
